contentText: A major investigation into an unprecedented data leak by Forbidden Stories exposes Russia's foreign influence strategy across three continents. The leak shows that journalists and publications were being paid to spread disinformation on behalf of the Kremlin through a network of experts known as The Company. FRANCE 24's Jean-Emile Jammine speaks with Forbidden Stories journalist Lea Peruchon about the revelations so far.
